items.description:
TAH Green Point is a veterinary hospital at 86 High Level Road in Green Point, Cape Town. The practice joined the TAH group in 2016 and runs a full hospital alongside a vet shop that sells premium pet food, merchandise and treats. Its services include vaccinations, consultations, dental care, surgery and specialist medicine.

The practice's own site says it is one of the most sought-after practices in the City Bowl, and it offers online booking as well as a contact form. The group lists emergency contacts at its Bellville and Rosmead branches. It suits pet owners in the City Bowl who want a full hospital and a retail shop in one place.

TEARS Animal Rescue, also known as The Emma Animal Rescue Society, is a non-profit animal welfare organisation based in Sunnydale, Cape Town. Its mission is to rescue, treat, rehabilitate and rehome domestic animals, and to provide veterinary services to local communities. It describes its aim as a sanctuary for companion animals in need.

The organisation runs community veterinary clinics in areas including Masiphumelele and Ocean View, and works with community and animal welfare groups. Its website offers ways to adopt and foster cats and dogs, and it runs a community cat project. It suits people who want to adopt, foster or support animal welfare in the Cape Peninsula.

The Fish Hoek Galley is a seafood restaurant at Bayside on Fish Hoek Beach, Cape Town. Its tagline is seafood at its best, and the menu runs from early until late. The Galley serves grilled prawns, linefish, seafood platters and classic fish and chips.

The Bayside complex also has the Beachcomber Bistro, where guests can eat on the beach or seated indoors, and the Drifters take-away for quick orders. The group says no booking is too large to accommodate. It suits families, groups and visitors to Fish Hoek who want seafood by the sea. Guests can eat on the beach or seated, according to the group's site.

The Happy Uncles is a halaal fine-dining restaurant in Salt River's Spice Yard on Voortrekker Road, Cape Town. It opened in 2021 and describes itself as bringing South Africa a halaal fine-dining experience with a primary focus on quality. The menu is built around tasting menus of four, six and eight courses, without pork or alcohol.

The restaurant's site lists its five-course and seven-course menus, and it has offered a winter special on these. It also takes reservations online and asks guests to give 24 hours' notice to cancel. The restaurant suits diners who want a refined tasting menu and a halaal dining experience in the city.

Wembley Meat Market is a butchery in the Wembley Building on Belgravia Road in Athlone, Cape Town, part of the Wembley Group of Companies. It sells exclusively A-grade halaal meats, sourced from local abattoirs and kept on an unbroken cold chain in its own walk-in refrigerators.

The market's polonies, cold meats and atchars are made in house, and its meat is delivered fresh every day. Its website says it draws customers from around the Peninsula. It suits households who want quality halaal meat and prepared products from a single butchery. Customers can buy fresh cuts as well as cold meats and atchars from the same counter.

Ashley's Family Restaurant is a long-standing family restaurant in Goodwood, Cape Town, at 123 Voortrekker Road. Its menu covers seafood, steaks, burgers, pasta, pizzas, ribs and chicken, and the restaurant hosts a carvery on Wednesday evenings and Sunday lunchtimes.

The restaurant offers deliveries and takeaways, and it publishes its Goodwood menu online as a PDF. Its website lists awards for social media mastery and service excellence in 2025, and its Facebook page describes it as Best in the Cape for several years. It suits families who want a broad, relaxed menu in Goodwood. The family also runs a Kraaifontein branch, which has its own menu and location page.

Authentic Aesthetics S.A is a beauty and aesthetics salon at 37 Ayrshire Street in Rondebosch East, Cape Town. Its services include facials and skincare, acne facials and acne treatments, dermaplaning, facial extractions and microdermabrasion.

The salon also offers body and skin treatments such as body sculpting, massage and makeup services, and it lists these on its Fresha booking page. Laser hair removal and skin-lightening treatments are also offered by appointment. The salon suits clients in Rondebosch East and nearby suburbs who want facial and body treatments close to home. Clients can book treatments online through its Fresha listing, which also shows the salon's address and services.

Basilico Steenberg is an Italian restaurant in Steenberg Village Centre in Tokai, Cape Town. The restaurant is known for its wood-fired pizzas, and its menu is wider than that. Starters include a roast pepper and artichoke salad, chicken tortellini in a mushroom and thyme cream sauce, and springbok carpaccio with pecorino.

Mains include grilled pork fillet with garlic and ginger sauce, and lamb cutlets with roasted red pepper and feta salad. The wine list features Constantia Valley labels alongside other South African wines. The restaurant is open from Monday to Sunday for lunch or dinner, and it suits friends, celebrations, romantic dates and corporate get-togethers.

BOA Beauty Bar is a nail and beauty salon in De Ville Centre on Wellington Road in Durbanville, Cape Town. Its services include gel manicures and pedicures, standard manicures and pedicures, acrylic nails, BIAB builder gel, PolyGel nails and Medicure pedicures.

The salon has a 4.7 rating from more than 9,000 reviews on its Fresha booking page, and clients can book online with instant confirmation. The salon also offers a men's pamper package, and it suits clients in Durbanville who want nail work and beauty treatments in a single visit. Clients can book online through its Fresha listing, which also shows the De Ville Centre address and the salon's services.

Body 20 Studio is an EMS training studio inside De Ville Centre in Durbanville, Cape Town. It offers 20-minute workouts that use electro-muscular stimulation, with a coach guiding each session. The studio says its sessions use advanced EMS technology with personalised coaching, with one coach for every two members.

The studio's site describes its training as a smarter 20-minute workout, and it says the team has been at this studio for more than a decade. Members can book a demo session online. It suits people who want to see results without spending hours in a conventional gym, and who prefer a guided, small-group approach.

The practice is a sport and spine physiotherapy clinic at Panorama Healthcare Centre on Hennie Winterbach Street in Panorama, Cape Town. It treats sports injuries, orthopaedic conditions, back and neck pain, and offers rehabilitation. The practice also offers dry needling as part of its treatment.

Patients can book online and choose their physiotherapist when they make a booking. The clinic lists separate rates for private patients and for those using medical aid. It suits people who want physiotherapy for sport, spine and musculoskeletal problems close to Panorama and nearby suburbs. The practice's site puts sports injury, orthopaedic and rehabilitation work at the centre of its services.

Cafe Extrablatt is a German-style all-day cafe on Main Road in Green Point, close to the Greenpoint Stadium. It is a double-storey venue with cosy nooks, sunny seating and outside spaces, and it has a full bar on both floors. The menu covers a breakfast buffet, pizzas and hamburgers, along with seasonal specials.

There is free parking opposite the venue, and the Mycity Greenpoint centre is a short walk away. Children are welcome, and the cafe serves crayons and milkshakes. Bookings are taken for both floors on weekdays and the downstairs area at weekends, with VIP seating upstairs on weekends. It suits families, groups and visitors to Green Point.

Cattle Baron Plattekloof is a steakhouse in Plattekloof Shopping Centre, Cape Town, and sits in the heart of the northern suburbs. It has been a prime spot for steak lovers for more than 20 years, and it is part of the Cattle Baron restaurant brand.

A buffet is offered on Wednesdays and Fridays, and the site has a gallery and franchise information. It suits families, groups and steak lovers in the northern suburbs who want a relaxed meal out. Its menu is built around steak, and the branch is part of the Cattle Baron restaurant chain. The branch's site includes a gallery and contact details for bookings.

CitiVet Gardens is a veterinary clinic at 7 Aandbloem Street in Vredehoek, Cape Town. Its services include consultations for diagnosis and annual check-ups, surgical procedures and laboratory work, and primary healthcare for new pets. The clinic says it can admit all surgical and medical cases to its hospital.

The clinic also stocks prescription veterinary food ranges and most other pet products, and it will order items it does not have in stock. Its site describes a helpful and friendly team available for pet-related questions. It suits pet owners in Vredehoek and the City Bowl who want a clinic that can handle both routine care and hospital admissions.

The firm is a medium-sized law practice with offices in Cape Town and Table View, at Unit 2, 42 Blaauwberg Road. It has offered legal services since 1999, and its site describes a commitment to personal attention for clients.

The practice covers conveyancing, commercial law, general litigation, family law, wills and trusts, and notarial services. Its website also offers cost calculators and resources to help clients understand the work. It suits homeowners, families and businesses in Table View and the northern suburbs who need an attorney for property or personal legal matters. Clients who need several kinds of legal work can deal with one practice, which the firm describes as a full suite of legal services.
